caption: A low water-level view shows calm sea under a bright, hazy sun just above the horizon, with a thin glare streaking the surface. The pointed white nose of a board, capped with a small dark tip, sits along the lower edge, while a dark coastline lies off to one side. As the viewpoint turns, the board nose shifts from the lower right out of frame, back to the lower right, toward the center, to the left edge, out of frame, and reappears at the left. The sun and its reflection sweep across the sky and water in step with this rotation, moving from center to the right, then left, and back toward the right. The horizon tilts at changing angles, and the coastline shifts out of view before returning at the far left. Near the middle, a hand enters the lower-right corner near a small splash, then withdraws. The water remains gently rippled, with no breaking wave or large wake visible.
